name: Artemis I: Path to the Pad
original_name: Artemis I: Path to the Pad
overview: Artemis I: Path to the Pad is a NASA+ documentary series that chronicles the technical preparation, assembly, and testing of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft ahead of the Artemis I lunar mission. The series provides an insider's look at the teams at Kennedy Space Center working to return humanity to the Moon.
